blocks.name: Foundations of Medicine
blocks.summary: Pharmacology, biochemistry and the craft of the medical interview.

blocks.name: Musculoskeletal & Gross Anatomy
blocks.summary: The anatomy lab, the upper limb, muscle and bone.

blocks.name: Cardiovascular
blocks.summary: The cardiac cycle, blood pressure and your first shift in the Emergency Department.

blocks.name: Pulmonary & Renal
blocks.summary: Breathing, gas exchange, the kidney and a day in clinic.

days.title: First Day of Classes
days.intro: Orientation is over. Today it starts for real: your first lecture, then an introduction to the hospital.

days.title: Pharmacokinetics and the Club Fair
days.intro: A morning of pharmacokinetics, then the student organizations set up on the quad.
days.between: Tuesday was a blur of small-group introductions and your first problem set.

days.title: Enzymes and the Microscope
days.intro: Biochemistry in the Medical Education Center, then your first histology lab.
days.between: The rest of the week settled into a rhythm: lectures in the mornings, flashcards at night.

days.title: Your First Patient Interview
days.intro: The Clinical Skills Center: a standardized patient, a closed door and ten minutes to take a history.
days.between: Tuesday and Wednesday: communication workshops and a practice interview with a classmate.

days.title: The White Coat Ceremony
days.intro: Families in the audience, the oath and the coat. A Saturday you will remember.
days.between: A week of lectures and reading. Your parents flew in on Friday night.

days.title: Block 1 Exam
days.intro: Five weeks of foundations, one exam. Breakfast first.
days.between: Two weeks of review sessions, practice questions and one very long study-group night.

days.title: The Anatomy Lab
days.intro: The donor dedication, then your first anatomy lecture of the block.
days.between: A week off after the exam. You slept, you cooked, you called home.

days.title: Muscle, Bone and the Upper Limb
days.intro: Muscle and bone physiology, then your first dissection of the upper limb.
days.between: Tuesday: anatomy prosection videos and the lab safety briefing.

days.title: The Musculoskeletal Exam
days.intro: Back to the Clinical Skills Center: a patient with knee pain.
days.between: Two weeks of lab sessions. You can name every branch of the brachial plexus in your sleep.

days.title: Before the Holiday
days.intro: A half day before Thanksgiving. The Community Kitchen serves its holiday meal tonight.
days.between: A week of review. The anatomy lab smells like the anatomy lab.

days.title: Anatomy Practical
days.intro: Tagged structures, timed stations. Identify, write, move on.
days.between: Thanksgiving with friends who couldn't fly home, then two weeks of practical review.

days.title: Block 2 Exam
days.intro: The last exam of the Fall term. Then winter break.

days.title: The Cardiac Cycle
days.intro: The Spring term starts with the heart: pressures, valves and sounds, then the ECG lab.
days.between: Winter break: two weeks at home, a lot of sleep and a little Anki.

days.title: Pressure and Pain
days.intro: Blood pressure regulation, then a standardized patient with chest pain.
days.between: A week of cardiac physiology problem sets.

days.title: Emergency Department Shift
days.intro: Clinical Immersion: an evening shift in the Emergency Department.
days.between: Heart sounds, ECG practice and a very loud study group.

days.title: Block 3 Exam
days.intro: The cardiovascular exam. Remember the pressure-volume loop.
days.between: Three weeks of lectures, cases and practice questions.

days.title: Breathe In
days.intro: Respiratory mechanics and gas exchange, then the spirometry lab.
days.between: A long weekend after the exam.

days.title: The Kidney
days.intro: Renal physiology and diuretics, then a patient who is short of breath.
days.between: A week of lung physiology and your first acid-base problems.

days.title: A Day in Clinic
days.intro: Clinical Immersion: an afternoon in the Family Medicine clinic.
days.between: Nephron diagrams on every whiteboard in the library.

days.title: Block 4 Exam
days.intro: Lungs and kidneys, one exam.
days.between: Two weeks of review. Spring is arriving.

days.title: Sugar
days.intro: Diabetes and glucose regulation, then a nutrition case conference.
days.between: Spring break: a few days off.

days.title: The Gut
days.intro: Digestion and the liver, then a patient with abdominal pain.
days.between: A week of endocrine lectures and insulin physiology.

days.title: Research Day
days.intro: The poster session in the morning, then Clinical Immersion on the wards.
days.between: A week of GI physiology and poster rehearsals.

days.title: Block 5 Exam
days.intro: Endocrine and GI.
days.between: Two weeks of review and one last push before the final block.

days.title: The Brain
days.intro: Motor pathways, then the neuroanatomy lab.
days.between: A weekend of rest before the final block.

days.title: Stroke
days.intro: Stroke syndromes, then a patient with sudden weakness.
days.between: A week of neuroanatomy.

days.title: The OSCE
days.intro: The end-of-year clinical skills exam: two stations, two patients.
days.between: A week of practice encounters with classmates.

days.title: The Last Day of M1
days.intro: The final block exam, then the end-of-year celebration.
days.between: One last week of review.
